subject: af-con
title: AF.CON.------WO.EXT.PRIN.
description: Chart on book p. 127 (T(AF)M-31). AF-CON (affinity convergence) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; WO-EXT-PRIN is the partner. From the subject: TR-INFO (trans-information), TR (transformation) and POL-DY (political dynamics). From POL-DY: C-F-ACT. From C-F-ACT: MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: ATTC (attachment), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From ATTC: SOC-RT (social reality). From SOC-RT: C-CULT-AT (composite culture attitude). From C-CULT-AT: ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics).
